title: FTSE Russell December 2026 reconstitution lock-down begins — the first December lock-down in the index family's history
source: EST: rule-derived from the index owner's ground rules, by the same two derivations that produced the June 2027 entry, which agree here too. FTSE Russell, "Russell US Equity Indexes" construction and methodology, v7.2, August 2026 (lseg.com dam PDF, HTTP 200, 746,491 bytes, text-extracted in-session 2026-09-06), Appendix F's DECEMBER column: Preliminary Information Released = "Four weeks prior to implementation", Query Period = "For two weeks following preliminary announcement", Lock down = "Two weeks after query period ends", Implementation = "2nd Friday of December". DERIVATION 1 (from the preliminary date): the December 2026 preliminary lists post Friday 2026-11-13 (tracked here as russell-recon-preliminary-2026-11-13, whose own initial research over-determined that date from five statements across four owner documents); two weeks later the query period ends Friday 2026-11-27, and lock-down begins the following MONDAY, 2026-11-30 -- prelim + 17 days, the same offset the current June regime runs. DERIVATION 2 (from the implementation date): implementation is Friday 2026-12-11 (tracked as russell-reconstitution-2026-12-11, and stated verbatim by the owner's own reconstitution page), and a two-business-week lock-down puts its first day at implementation Friday - 11 days = Monday 2026-11-30. Both return the same Monday. THE MONDAY CONVENTION is confirmed against all seven June instances the owner has published a lock-down date for -- 2020-06-15, 2021-06-14, 2022-06-13, 2023-06-05, 2024-06-10, 2025-06-09, 2026-06-08, each read this session off FTSE Russell's own schedule press release for that year, all seven the Monday after the query period ends -- and the 11-day implementation offset is exactly the one the 2020-2022 June regime ran (prelim 06-05/06-04/06-03, lock-down 06-15/06-14/06-13, implementation 06-26/06-25/06-24). WHY IT IS ONLY ESTIMATE, stated plainly: FTSE Russell has published preliminary and update dates for December 2026 (11-13, then 11-20 / 11-27 / 12-04 / 12-11) but this session found NO owner-published December schedule naming a lock-down date -- there has never been a December reconstitution, so the December Monday convention is applied, not observed. A specific risk is named rather than glossed: the query period ends Friday 2026-11-27, the day after Thanksgiving and a 1:00 p.m. ET half session (tracked as thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27), which is exactly the kind of week an owner might shift by a day. Promote on an FTSE Russell December 2026 schedule or index notice naming the lock-down date. Discovered during the russell-recon-lockdown-2027-06-07 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-recon-lockdown-2027-06-07 initial research (2026-09-06). WHY IT IS WORTH A CALENDAR ENTRY: it is the FIRST December lock-down in the Russell family's history, 85 days out where the June 2027 instance is 274, and it is the only near-term out-of-sample test of everything the June 2027 ledger measured -- the lock-down day's null (IWM-vs-SPY +0.013% mean, p=45.3% across seven Junes) and the query-to-lock-down volume ramp (0.97x to 1.16x of trailing-60d median, higher in 6 of 7 years, sign-flip permutation p=8.6%). Both of that ledger's tape-scored forward tests, FT-russell-recon-lockdown-2027-06-07-1 and -2, score on this date. THE SIBLING THAT OWNS THE DECEMBER ANNOUNCEMENT DELIBERATELY PROPOSED NO ADJACENCY (russell-recon-preliminary-2026-11-13, 2026-09-06: the Russell Monitor List is subscriber-only and each update Friday collides with an already-tracked event) -- its reasoning did not reach the lock-down date, which is neither subscriber-only nor colliding with an existing entry, so this proposal extends that lane rather than contradicting it. A CONFOUND IS NAMED AT PROPOSAL TIME, not left for the researcher to find: 2026-11-30 carries a heavy corridor -- 21 tracked events sit within five days, including pce-2026-11-25 and gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25 (both high) at T-3, fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28 at T-2, chicago-pmi-2026-11-30 and dallas-fed-mfg-2026-11-30 on the day itself, and georgia-senate-runoff-2026-12-01 plus ism-manufacturing-2026-12-01 (both high) at T+1. A December lock-down-day tape read is therefore weak evidence in both directions, and the June 2027 ledger registers it as such. A SECOND, STRUCTURAL REASON THE TEST IS WEAK, also stated up front: the owner's own November 2025 parallel run puts December's R2000 turnover at 5.37% against June 2025's actual 10.43%, so any December flow effect should be roughly half-size by construction -- a December pass is weak confirmation, a December kill is strong disconfirmation. Impact low, status estimate: no shares move on this date, nothing is published on it, no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits), shorting is blocked house-wide. Kind `sector` matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
